items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued September 12 at 2:47PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
The areas affected include...
Tampa Bay waters...

At 247 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm, capable
of producing winds to around 30 knots. This thunderstorm was located
over Old Tampa Bay, moving east at 10 knots.
items.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, and lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe harbor
immediately until this storm passes.
